BiblicalUsage: Harumaph is named once, as the father of Jedaiah, who repaired the wall of Jerusalem over against his own house. Jedaiah worked the stretch in front of his own door, and his father's name is kept on the record of it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the detail is the devotion: Jedaiah repaired the stretch of wall in front of his own front door.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
